fact: Minister Julien Paluku said 93 of 98 foreign-trade documents are dematerialised through the Guichet unique intégral du commerce extérieur, whose system is connected to DGDA's SYDONIA World customs system for electronic transmission of the documentary set.
system: Guichet unique intégral du commerce extérieur

fact: An interministerial circular of 17 Dec 2025 says trials of electronic transmission of the documentary set from S-ONE to SYDONIA World roll out in phases from 29 Dec 2025 (Kinshasa, then Haut-Katanga and Lualaba, then Kongo Central), with the obligation generalised nationwide from 18 Feb 2026.

The Prime Minister officially launched electronic transmission of the import, export and transit documentary set from SEGUCE's S-ONE platform into SYDONIA World, DGDA's automated system, and the Finance Minister said operators must now use this channel.

Electronic transmission of the GUICE document bundle to the SYDONIA World customs system is deployed in Haut-Katanga (Lubumbashi, Kasumbalesa, Sakania), Lualaba and Kongo-Central, with N'djili airport from 1 July 2026.

The Guichet unique integral du commerce exterieur (GUICE) sends documents electronically to customs and the administrations involved in import and export, deployed in three provinces in June 2026, per SEGUCE RDC and DGDA.

The WCO says the DGDA and Zambia Revenue Authority held the inaugural steering committee of the Kasumbalesa customs systems interconnectivity project on 1 November 2024, approving its work programme, with data exchange targeted for May 2025.
The DRC foreign trade ministry says trade documents are transmitted electronically into the customs directorate's SYDONIA World system with the goods declaration, and that this is to be consolidated.

The DRC foreign trade ministry says 67 of the 77 items of the import, export and transit document bundle were already dematerialised through the GUCE integrated single window, linking customs and other agencies.
